# Become a CWB Junior Instructor

## We start taking applications for Junior Instructors in January for the 2027 summer season!

The Junior Instructor Program is a volunteer leadership development program for students who want to build sailing or woodworking skills and maritime experience. Junior Instructors often go on to become paid summer camp instructors.

### Junior instructor program Requirements
- **Ages:** 14-17 years old
- **Position:** Volunteer
- [Download our information sheet here](https://www.cwb.org/s/Junior-Instructor-Broshure-1.pdf)

Requirements:
- Small boat or woodworking experience preferred
- Work responsibly on a team and serve as a role model for campers
- Help create a positive, encouraging environment
- Enjoy working with youth ages 8-14
- Commit to at least 3 weeks during peak summer season (3-5 weeks gives the greatest benefit)
- Complete 24 hours of virtual, in-person, and on-the-water training (May/June)
- Lift light to medium items (20-50 lbs) solo, and heavy items (50-100 lbs) with assistance
- CPR/AED/First Aid certification from a USCG-approved provider (CWB provides one free at the WEC; date TBA)
- WA Boater Education Card: [Take Your Washington Boater Safety Course Online | BoatEd](https://www.boat-ed.com/washington/?campaignid=31369484&adgroupid=1244647735094562&keyword=boaters%20license&msclkid=54c90c2676ac1d38f27d6b1841ee2344&utm_source=bing&utm_medium=cpc&utm_campaign=boat-ed_boat_washington_tier1lc&utm_term=boaters%20license&utm_content=Exact_License)
- US Sailing SafeSport (free online): [US Sailing SafeSport](https://www.ussailing.org/competition/resources/safesport-us-sailing/)

### What does a Junior Instructor do?
Junior Instructors gain job and maritime skills while supporting CWB operations. They help instructors with daily tasks such as preparing the classroom and assisting on and off the water, and may work with summer camp sailors on on-water safety, rigging, and sailing technique. Volunteer hours can count as community service hours.

### Why Become a Junior Instructor
- Training in on-water and boat safety
- Volunteer experience and hours, with potential to earn the Presidential Volunteer Service Award
- Letter of recommendation on request
- CPR/First Aid training
- Off-season discount on Youth Programs
- Friendships with other Junior Instructors and instructors
- Free child addition to CWB membership after 45+ logged volunteer hours

## If you have read the information above and want to be a Junior Instructor...
Fill out the application form [HERE](https://docs.google.com/forms/d/1DWgJ3bRxhaopLsW4JByOMk_jn8cRZhulo2glTtMEStk/).
